title: Funny Additions
description: adds some cool, funny, nice stuff that you can prank friends with (or get confused yourself)
body:
a silly minecraft mod. nothing too serious.

what's inside:

screaming block (steps on it. it screams.)

slime on a stick (right click to launch yourself)

fake diamond sword (looks real. deals 0 damage.)

reverse helmet (locks your camera facing one way)

future chestplate (deletes the ground under you. yes really.)

tppweyf™ (explosive poison potato. throw it.)

bouncy block (boing but higher)

o2 (edible air. yes. air.)

the yeeter (launches anything you hit)

bread flavored dirt (tastes like bread. still dirt.)

screaming jetpack (fly up. it screams. then explodes.)

smile which raises happiness (full heal. one time.)

smile which lowers happiness (you can guess)

plus a few blocks, armor pieces, and probably way more.

works with forge.

not balanced. just funny.
